name: VOLT 808 — Analog Drum Synthesizer & Sequencer
description: A tactile vintage analog drum synthesizer and step sequencer featuring synthesized TR-808, Rack Kick, Spinz 808, Zay 808, and Hit 1 Hi-Hat engines, deep modulation, live preset swapping, and 24-bit stereo WAV, AIFF, FLAC, and MIDI export.
